question: What is the meaning of material composition in relation to material composition?
description: Material composition refers to the specific combination of substances that make up a material. In the context of the provided text, material composition is crucial for promoting transparency and understanding the properties of materials used in products. It involves knowing the exact proportions and types of substances present in a material, which can be complex and often requires additional contextual information. This information is essential for sustainable production and consumption, as it helps in optimizing the selection, processing, and assembly of materials, as well as facilitating their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of a product's life cycle.

Composition properties
Figure 5 shows the composition property facet. This block of ontology helps to optimise
the selection, processing, and assembly of the constituent parts and materials of a product
and facilitates their separation, dismantling, and recycling at the end of life of a product
to maximise the circularity.
Figure 5: Composition property facet of the MPO.
CompositionProperty has two subclasses, ConstituentPart and ConstituentMaterial. For
example, crossbeam has constituent materials carbon fibre, glass fibre, epoxy resin, alu-
minium, foam, and film adhesive that have mass, and a source and destination in a circular
economy.
